title: Wednesday at Three (बुधवार को तीन बजे)

scenes.title: सिर्फ़ बगल वाला पड़ोसी
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbor returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: एप्रन में कमांडर
scenes.summary: At six o'clock Wednesday morning, Tessa sits with her ankle on pillows directing Owen's bread kneading and Hannah's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: मिलीमीटर से कटी गाजर
scenes.summary: Caleb chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Owen and Tessa tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: कमरा नंबर नौ की सजावट
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Hannah, Evelyn, and Graham lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small green leaves on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: भाषण जेब में रखिए
scenes.summary: At five minutes to three, Arthur nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Hannah and Graham convince him to welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: विरासत की मुहर
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Evelyn to play.

scenes.title: रसोई में चाय की सलामी
scenes.summary: Listening to Evelyn's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Tessa, Caleb, and Owen clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: दरवाज़े पर गूँजती धुन
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Arthur, Hannah, and Evelyn learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who played Friday duets with Arthur's aunt thirty years ago.
